Multiple headings create multiple Heading nodes with correct levels

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"include_document_structure\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<h1>Main Title</h1><h2>Section One</h2><p>Section one content.</p><h2>Section Two</h2><p>Section two content.</p>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
